Kanban 534432532, DUNGEON_NORTHSTAR.md Milestone 3. New server/mob/dungeon.go: DungeonRoster carries §7's real 8-named-dungeon boss/elite content pass as Go data. GFD commit 433cafc, milestone table updated to IN PROGRESS. Real, honest, deliberately not done: every spawn's Kind carries the real hero identifier as a placeholder -- actually driving REDGARDEN's apns/arena_bot AI as that hero is separate, later, harder cross-repo work named directly in the northstar. session: sess-20260902-2008-ed50169e
